scope: Lossless GPU transfer ablation: decode critical fallback predecessors first, then overlap remaining SplitZip fallback decode with rANS. The reference is unchanged mapped-I/O plus selective-context decoding. Identical original BF16 words, fitted state and frozen TABLES k2/k14 masks; both arms must preserve complete prior bundled packets. No refitting or TEST policy selection. These two documents are reused for development, not independent generalization evidence. Complete GPU calls and actual serialized bytes; serial link calculations are not NIC/SSD, resident P, lossy quality or serving measurements.
